QF.id: VI Debt Instruments and Government Securities_20

question.text: What is the maturity period of Dated Securities?

explanation.text: The Logic: Dated Securities have a maturity period of more than one year, distinguishing them from Treasury Bills which are up to one year. The Trap: Exactly 5 years is a common tenor but dated securities can have various maturities beyond one year. Note: Classification of government securities by maturity is tested in NISM Series VI.
